description: Angular component for managing Asset entities in the Thingsboard UI, including form building, update, and notification handling.

classes.name: AssetComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent to handle AssetInfo entities, including form management and user notifications.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting asset scope and calling parent initialization.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if delete option should be hidden based on configuration.

methods.name: isAssignedToCustomer
methods.description: Checks if the asset is assigned to a customer based on customerId.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs a reactive form for AssetInfo with validation.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Patches form values with the provided AssetInfo entity.

methods.name: onAssetIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches a notification when the asset ID is copied.

methods.name: onAssetProfileUpdated
methods.description: Updates table data after asset profile change.
